theBlocker.cause: Commit e258e47a0 'Measure a drawn string with the font the page actually uses' (2026-09-09) changed the shared module scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs so groupIntoLines emits run.x2 as NULL rather than x + 0 for a run it cannot measure. captureWidgetContext, in that same module, harvests a widget's printed caption with `if (run.x2 > rect.x + 1) continue;` and then `gap = rect.x - run.x2`. With x2 null that test is false and the gap coerces to rect.x, so the caption is discarded. DC 1:15's caption runs are exactly the ones that became unmeasurable -- the same commit's own message names 'NE DC-1-15' as the two-byte-code case.
theBlocker.proof: Decisive, and run both ways in this worktree. theBlocker.whyIDidNotBuildThroughIt: Because the assertion is right and the packet it would refuse is worse than no packet. Rebuilding on the current module loses the printed label on 26 of this family's 102 mapped rows and, because the role classification is derived from that label, turns NINE court- and service-owned blanks into tasks handed to the participant: requiredBeforeFilingCount goes from 21 to 30, and DC-1-15 Text44 -- printed label '__________________________, Judge of the ___________________' -- goes from 'court-owned field: the court, clerk or prosecutor completes it, not the participant' to 'a participant or case fact the filing needs ... must be supplied before filing'.
